name: Account
description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

name: AdvId
description: Unique identifier of advertisement message.

name: AdvRefID
description: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE transaction types.

name: AdvSide
description: Broker's side of advertised trade

name: AdvTransType
description: Identifies advertisement message transaction type

name: AvgPx
description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

name: BeginSeqNo
description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent

name: BeginString
description: Identifies beginning of new message and session protocol version by means of a session profile identifier (see FIX Session Layer for details). ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted).

name: BodyLength
description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

name: CheckSum
description: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

name: ClOrdID
description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary etc.) (identified by SenderCompID(49) or OnBehalfOfCompID(115) as appropriate). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms, particularly those which electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID(11) field.

name: Commission
description: Commission. Note if CommType (13) is percentage, Commission of 5% should be represented as .05.

name: CommType
description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the total commission based on the rate.

name: CumQty
description: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

name: Currency
description: Identifies currency used for price or quantity fields, depending on the asset class being traded. CurrencyCodeSource(2897) may be used to disambiguate the code source scheme used, and ISO 4217 is the default scheme if absent.

name: EndSeqNo
description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo (7) = EndSeqNo. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = "0" (representing infinity).

name: ExecID
description: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) for ExecType (150)=I (Order Status)).

name: ExecInst
description: Instructions for order handling on exchange trading floor. If more than one instruction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

values.meaning: Fixed peg to local best bid or offer at time of order
Single execution requested for block trade
Execute as delta neutral using volatility provided

name: ExecRefID
description: Reference identifier used with Trade, Trade Cancel and Trade Correct execution types.

name: ExecTransType
description: Deprecated in FIX.4.2 *** REPLACED FIELD - See: Appendix 6-F: 1.Replaced Field: ExecTransType (tag 20) and values in ExecType and OrdStatus fields [replaced in FIX 4.3] *** Identifies transaction type

name: HandlInst
description: Instructions for order handling on Broker trading floor

values.meaning: Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention
Automated execution order, public, Broker intervention OK

name: SecurityIDSource
description: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID(48) value.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: IOIID
description: Unique identifier of IOI message.

name: IOIOthSvc
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.1

name: IOIQltyInd
description: Relative quality of indication

name: IOIRefID
description: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE, transaction types.

name: IOIQty
description: Quantity (e.g. number of shares) in numeric form or relative size.

name: IOITransType
description: Identifies IOI message transaction type

name: LastCapacity
description: Broker capacity in order execution

name: LastMkt
description: Market of execution for last fill, or an indication of the market where an order was routed

name: LastPx
description: Price of this (last) fill.

name: LastQty
description: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

name: NoLinesOfText
description: Identifies number of lines of text body

name: MsgSeqNum
description: Integer message sequence number.

name: MsgType
description: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

name: NewSeqNo
description: New sequence number

name: OrderID
description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

name: OrderQty
description: Quantity ordered. This represents the number of shares for equities or par, face or nominal value for FI instruments.

name: OrdStatus
description: Identifies current status of order. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

values.meaning: Pending Cancel (i.e. result of Order Cancel Request)
Pending Replace (i.e. result of Order Cancel/Replace Request)

name: OrdType
description: Order type.

values.meaning: Funari (Limit day order with unexecuted portion handles as Market On Close. E.g. Japan)
Market With Left Over as Limit
Previous Fund Valuation Point (Historic pricing; for CIV)
Next Fund Valuation Point (Forward pricing; for CIV)
Stop Limit on Bid or Offer

name: OrigClOrdID
description: ClOrdID (11) of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the institution, used to identify the previous order in cancel and cancel/replace requests.

name: OrigTime
description: Time of message origination (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT"))

name: PossDupFlag
description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

name: Price
description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

name: RefSeqNum
description: Reference message sequence number

name: RelatdSym
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.1

name: SecurityID
description: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

name: SenderCompID
description: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

name: SenderSubID
description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

name: SendingDate
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.3

name: SendingTime
description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

name: Quantity
description: Overall/total quantity (e.g. number of shares)

name: Side
description: Side of order (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

values.meaning: Cross (orders where counterparty is an exchange, valid for all messages except IOIs)

name: Symbol
description: Ticker symbol. Common, "human understood" representation of the security. SecurityID (48) value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles)

name: TargetCompID
description: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

name: TargetSubID
description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

name: Text
description: Free format text string

name: TimeInForce
description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY. NOTE not applicable to CIV Orders.

name: TransactTime
description: Timestamp when the business transaction represented by the message occurred.

name: Urgency
description: Urgency flag

name: ValidUntilTime
description: Indicates expiration time of indication message (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

name: SettlType
description: Indicates order settlement period. If present, SettlDate (64) overrides this field. If both SettlType (63) and SettDate (64) are omitted, the default for SettlType (63) is 0 (Regular)

values.meaning: Regular / FX Spot settlement (T+1 or T+2 depending on currency)
FX Spot Next settlement (Spot+1, aka next day)

name: SettlDate
description: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.

name: SymbolSfx
description: Additional information about the security (e.g. preferred, warrants, etc.). Note also see SecurityType (167).

values.meaning: EUCP with lump-sum interest rather than discount price
"When Issued" for a security to be reissued under an old CUSIP or ISIN

name: ListID
description: Unique identifier for list as assigned by institution, used to associate multiple individual orders. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which generate multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the ListID field to assure uniqueness across days.

name: ListSeqNo
description: Sequence of individual order within list (i.e. ListSeqNo of TotNoOrders (68), 2 of 25, 3 of 25, . . . )

name: TotNoOrders
description: Total number of list order entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoOrders (73) in each message that has repeating list order entries related to the same ListID (66). Used to support fragmentation.

name: ListExecInst
description: Free format text message containing list handling and execution instructions.

name: AllocID
description: Unique identifier for allocation message.

name: AllocTransType
description: Identifies allocation transaction type *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" ***

values.meaning: Calculated without Preliminary (sent unsolicited by broker, includes MiscFees and NetMoney) (Removed/Replaced)

name: RefAllocID
description: Reference identifier to be used with AllocTransType (71) = Replace or Cancel.

name: NoOrders
description: Indicates number of orders to be combined for average pricing and allocation.

name: AvgPxPrecision
description: Indicates number of decimal places to be used for average pricing. Absence of this field indicates that default precision arranged by the broker/institution is to be used.

name: TradeDate
description: Indicates date of trading day. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

name: ExecBroker
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2 *** REPLACED FIELD - See Appendix 6-F: 3.Replaced Fields: ExecBroker (tag 76), BrokerOfCredit (tag 92), ClientID (tag 109), ClearingFirm (tag 439), ClearingAccount (tag 440), and SettlLocation (tag 166) [Replaced in FIX 4.3] *** Identifies executing / give-up broker. Standard NASD market-maker mnemonic is preferred.

name: PositionEffect
description: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

name: NoAllocs
description: Number of repeating AllocAccount (79)/AllocPrice (366) entries.

name: AllocAccount
description: Sub-account mnemonic

name: AllocQty
description: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account

name: ProcessCode
description: Processing code for sub-account. Absence of this field in AllocAccount (79) / AllocPrice (366) /AllocQty (80) / ProcessCode instance indicates regular trade.

name: NoRpts
description: Total number of reports within series.

name: RptSeq
description: Sequence number of message within report series. Used to carry reporting sequence number of the fill as represented on the Trade Report Side.

name: CxlQty
description: Total quantity canceled for this order.

name: NoDlvyInst
description: Number of delivery instruction fields in repeating group.

name: DlvyInst
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2. No longer used. Included here for reference to prior versions. Free format text field to indicate delivery instructions

name: AllocStatus
description: Identifies status of allocation.

name: AllocRejCode
description: Identifies reason for rejection.

values.meaning: Incorrect or missing fund ID or fund name
Incorrect or missing settlement currency instructions

name: Signature
description: Electronic signature

name: SecureDataLen
description: Length of encrypted message

name: SecureData
description: Actual encrypted data stream

name: BrokerOfCredit
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2 *** REPLACED FIELD - See Appendix 6-F: 3.Replaced Fields: ExecBroker (tag 76), BrokerOfCredit (tag 92), ClientID (tag 109), ClearingFirm (tag 439), ClearingAccount (tag 440), and SettlLocation (tag 166) [Replaced in FIX 4.3] *** Broker to receive trade credit.

name: SignatureLength
description: Number of bytes in signature field

name: EmailType
description: Email message type.

name: RawDataLength
description: Number of bytes in raw data field.

name: RawData
description: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

name: PossResend
description: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

name: EncryptMethod
description: Method of encryption.

values.meaning: PGP / DES-MD5 (See app note on FIX web site)
PEM / DES-MD5 (see app note on FIX web site)

name: StopPx
description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

name: ExDestination
description: Execution destination as defined by institution when order is entered.

name: CxlRejReason
description: Code to identify reason for rejection of cancellation or modification.

values.meaning: Order already in Pending Cancel or Pending Replace status
Unable to process Order Mass Cancel Request
OrigOrdModTime (586) did not match last TransactTime (60) of order

name: OrdRejReason
description: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Note: Values 3, 4, and 5 will be used when rejecting an order due to pre-allocation information errors.

values.meaning: Duplicate of a verbally communicated order
Short sell rejected due to security pre-borrow restriction
Short sell rejected due to account pre-borrow restriction

name: IOIQualifier
description: Code to qualify IOI use. (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

values.meaning: At the close (around/not held to close)
At the Market (previously called Current Quote)

name: WaveNo
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2

name: Issuer
description: Name of security issuer (e.g. International Business Machines, GNMA).

name: SecurityDesc
description: Can be used by the venue or one of the trading parties to provide a non-normative textual description for the financial instrument.

name: HeartBtInt
description: Heartbeat interval (seconds)

name: ClientID
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2 *** REPLACED FIELD - See Appendix 6-F: 3.Replaced Fields: ExecBroker (tag 76), BrokerOfCredit (tag 92), ClientID (tag 109), ClearingFirm (tag 439), ClearingAccount (tag 440), and SettlLocation (tag 166) [Replaced in FIX 4.3] *** Firm identifier used in third party-transactions (should not be a substitute for OnBehalfOfCompID <115> / DeliverToCompID <128> ).

name: MinQty
description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.

name: MaxFloor
description: The quantity to be displayed . Required for reserve orders. On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

name: TestReqID
description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat

name: ReportToExch
description: Identifies party of trade responsible for exchange reporting.

values.meaning: Indicates the party sending message will report trade
Indicates the party receiving message must report trade

name: LocateReqd
description: Indicates whether the broker is to locate the stock in conjunction with a short sell order.

values.meaning: Indicates the broker is not required to locate
Indicates the broker is responsible for locating the stock

name: OnBehalfOfCompID
description: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

name: OnBehalfOfSubID
description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

name: QuoteID
description: Unique identifier for quote

name: NetMoney
description: Total amount due as the result of the transaction (e.g. for Buy order - principal + commission + fees) reported in currency of execution.

name: SettlCurrAmt
description: Total amount due expressed in settlement currency (includes the effect of the forex transaction)

name: SettlCurrency
description: Currency code of settlement denomination.

name: ForexReq
description: Indicates request for forex accommodation trade to be executed along with security transaction.

values.meaning: Do Not Execute Forex After Security Trade

name: OrigSendingTime
description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

name: GapFillFlag

values.meaning: Sequence Reset, Ignore Msg Seq Num (N/A For FIXML - Not Used)
Gap Fill Message, Msg Seq Num Field Valid

name: CxlType
description: Deprecated in FIX 4.2

name: ExpireTime

name: DKReason

name: DeliverToCompID
description: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

name: DeliverToSubID
description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

name: IOINaturalFlag
description: Indicates that IOI is the result of an existing agency order or a facilitation position resulting from an agency order, not from principal trading or order solicitation activity.

name: QuoteReqID
description: Unique identifier for a QuoteRequest(35=R).

name: BidPx

name: OfferPx

name: BidSize

name: OfferSize
description: Quantity of offer

name: PrevClosePx

name: TargetLocationID

name: DeliverToLocationID
description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

name: NoRelatedSym

name: Subject

name: Headline

name: URLLink

description: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus (39) is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

name: CashOrderQty
description: Specifies the approximate order quantity desired in total monetary units vs. as tradeable units (e.g. number of shares). name: AllocAvgPx

name: AllocNetMoney

name: SettlCurrFxRate

name: SettlCurrFxRateCalc

name: NumDaysInterest
description: Number of Days of Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income. Note value may be negative.

name: AccruedInterestRate
description: The amount the buyer compensates the seller for the portion of the next coupon interest payment the seller has earned but will not receive from the issuer because the issuer will send the next coupon payment to the buyer. name: AccruedInterestAmt
